lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five vertical columns and six horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters are arranged in a quasi-grid pattern posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal spot rows to form visible anchor points of high luminance across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent longitudinal ridge on the upper flank exhibits a sharp vertical luminance gradient, characterized by a light-toned upper edge and a shadowed lower edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of high-luminance blobs is visible on the first dorsal fin, primarily concentrated near the base and posterior margin.

other_distinctive_markers: High-density clustering of small, uniform-sized high-luminance spots is visible across the dorsal surface of the primary pectoral fin.
